tools.name: release_hold
tools.description: Use this when the person no longer wants a time you held for them and has not confirmed it. Ends the hold at once, so the time is free again. Do not use for cancelling a confirmed booking: release_hold only ends a hold that is still waiting, and the person cancels a booking with the business.
